question.instructions: Predict the pitch a baseball pitcher is about to throw using ONLY his body language before release (set position and the start of the leg lift): glove/hand position, grip motion, elbows, posture. Evidence: (1) a vision model's calibrated probabilities, (2) the pitches thrown on the most visually similar past deliveries, (3) this pitcher's known tells with today's readings. Weigh agreeing evidence; when evidence is weak, stay close to the arsenal base rates. The vision model's track record on unseen games tells you how far to trust its confidence: follow it where it has been reliable, discount it where it has not.

known_tells.tell: When throwing elbow flare in the set is high → SL 65% of the time (vs 52% overall, AUC 0.68, q=1.51e-16)
When torso lean change at leg lift is low → FF 59% of the time (vs 48% overall, AUC 0.38, q=1.45e-07)
When glove-arm elbow bend 2 frames into leg lift (vs his set) is low → FF 56% of the time (vs 48% overall, AUC 0.39, q=1.19e-06)
When glove-arm elbow bend change at leg lift is high → SL 60% of the time (vs 52% overall, AUC 0.61, q=1.87e-06)
When throwing-arm elbow bend in the set is low → FF 56% of the time (vs 48% overall, AUC 0.39, q=2.24e-06)
When glove-hand height change at leg lift is high → FF 57% of the time (vs 48% overall, AUC 0.60, q=4.33e-06)
